Use browser tools to inspect it before answering. You can request screenshots,

Is there a correlation between achievements and average playtime? (A) Strong positive (B) Weak positive (C) No relationship. Answer with just the letter.
Achievements vs Average Playtime

arguments.script: (()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('#chart path[aria-label]')];let a=p.map(e=>{let s=e.getAttribute('aria-label');return [+s.match(/Number of achievements: ([\d.]+)/)[1],+s.match(/Average playtime \(minutes\): ([\d.]+)/)[1]]});let n=a.length,mx=a.reduce((s,v)=>s+v[0],0)/n,my=a.reduce((s,v)=>s+v[1],0)/n;let cov=a.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v[0]-mx)*(v[1]-my),0),xx=a.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v[0]-mx)**2,0),yy=a.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v[1]-my)**2,0);return {n,r:cov/Math.sqrt(xx*yy)}})()
